name: STEM week AI demo for children

mentions.name: STEM week AI demo for children
mentions.description: An interactive demo that teaches children how AI works using a very small training data set: the user writes the beginning of a one-sentence story, the tool keeps track of a configurable number of tokens and generates a given number of them, and users can step through the process, with support for multiple models.
mentions.audience: Children at the author's daughter's school for STEM week
mentions.source_excerpt: Started a project to demonstrate AÍ to children. Uses very small training data set, you can write the beginning of a one sentence story, it can keep track of a configurable number of tokens, generates a given number of them. Allows taking steps through the process.
